question: Is the successful eight-job hosted-runner coverage sufficient for this setup-node major update, or should the Pages and Crabbox hydration paths be run directly before merge?
rationale: The common setup-node configurations are well exercised, but two changed workflows use specialized triggers whose end-to-end paths are not represented in the listed checks.

options.title: Accept Current Coverage

options.title: Run Specialized Paths
options.body: Manually validate the Pages and Crabbox hydration workflows on this exact head before merging.
